mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, preventing tamsulosin metabolism and increasing sympathomimetic effects; combined alpha-blockade and MAOI effects increase hypotension and potential hypertensive crisis risk with sympathomimetic accumulation.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if essential, use lowest tamsulosin dose with careful blood pressure monitoring and extended washout period (14 days) after phenelzine discontinuation.
